ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

2. This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.147/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Neemuch (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376 (2) (n), 201, 323, 506 of IPC .
3 . Prosecution story, in brief, is that the prosecutrix is aged about 28 yeas and she is already married and having three children.
She was living with her husband at village Manpura.
Due to some dispute with her husband she left her husband and used to live with her children.
On 21.03.2023 the applicant on false pretext marriage assaulted her and threatened her and committed rape upon her.

On the basis of complaint, FIR was lodged on 31.03.2023 against the applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated.
Applicant was in love with the prosecutrix.
FIR was lodged after four months and 26 days from the date of the incident, without any explanation regarding cause of delay.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
He is in custody since 01.04.2023.
The trial will take sufficient long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the present applicant/accused be released on bail.
5 . On the other hand, learned Government Advocate for the non- applicant/State has objected the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and also considering the facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that final disposal of the case will take sufficient long time, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence,
without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant- Rakesh shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) alongwith one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for his appearance presence before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
7.
With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
